### workspace step --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace step done [--status pass|fail] [--summary TEXT] [--code WORD] [--json]
       workspace step status [--json]

For the agent working on a workflow step, run from the pane the run is bound to.
Neither is required: a step is decided when the agent's turn ends, from the files it
was told to leave and the step's check (see `workspace workflow --help`).

  done    Record what you say about a workflow step, then end your turn
  status  Show which workflow run, step and attempt this pane is on
Run `workspace step VERB --help` for a verb's options.

        --status STATUS              done: pass (default) or fail
        --summary TEXT               done: one line about what was done, or what is left
        --code WORD                  done: a word for why, kept with a failed step: starts with a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits, _ (at most 40); not one the engine uses (e.g. check_failed, head_moved)
        --json                       Print one JSON document (see docs/README.workflow.md)
    -h, --help                       Show this help

Examples:
  workspace step status    # which run, step and attempt this pane is on
  workspace step done --summary "Plan written; three commits."    # record a pass, then end your turn
  workspace step done --status fail --summary "Two specs still fail in billing."    # fail the step at the turn's end
  workspace step done --status fail --code not_reproduced --summary "The failure did not happen locally."    # fail it with a word for why
--- stderr
--- end

### workspace step done --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace step done [--status pass|fail] [--summary TEXT] [--code WORD] [--json]

Record what you say about a workflow step, then end your turn.

For the agent working on a workflow step, run from the pane the run is bound to. --status fail fails
the step at the turn's end without running its check. It is not required: a step is decided when the
agent's turn ends, from the files it was told to leave and the step's check (see `workspace
workflow --help`).

Options:
    --status STATUS              pass (default) or fail
    --summary TEXT               One line about what was done, or what is left
    --code WORD                  A word for why, kept with a failed step: starts with a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits, _ (at most 40); not one the engine uses (e.g. check_failed, head_moved)
    --json                       Print one JSON document
    -h, --help                   Show this help

Examples:
  workspace step done    # record a pass for the step your pane is on; then end your turn
  workspace step done --summary "Plan written; three commits."    # record a pass with one line on what was done
  workspace step done --status fail --summary "Two specs still fail in billing."    # fail the step when the turn ends, without running its check
  workspace step done --status fail --code not_reproduced --summary "The failure did not happen locally."    # fail it with a word for why, kept with the failed step
  workspace step done --summary "Docs written" --json    # the same as one JSON document; outside a run's pane it exits 1 with not_bound
--- stderr
--- end

### workspace step status --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace step status [--json]

Show which workflow run, step and attempt this pane is on.

Also shows where the step's instructions are, and whether the files the step must leave are there: written this attempt, non-empty, regular files and not links (problem names the rule broken). Run
from the pane the run is bound to.

Options:
    --json                       Print one JSON document
    -h, --help                   Show this help

Examples:
  workspace step status    # which workflow run, step and attempt this pane is on, and the files the step must leave
  workspace step status --json    # the same as one JSON document, with whether each file is there (produces); outside a run's pane it exits 1 with not_bound
  workspace step status --json | jq '.step.produces'    # list the files the step must leave, and whether each was written this attempt (current)
--- stderr
--- end
